env.name: SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN
env.description: The store's myshopify.com address, e.g. "my-store.myshopify.com" (not its public domain).

env.name: SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN
env.description: An Admin API access token (starts "shpat_") from a custom app installed on the store, with the read_orders and write_orders scopes. See this ability's README.

env.name: SHOPIFY_API_VERSION
env.description: Optional. The Admin API version to call, e.g. "2025-10". Leave unset to use this ability's default; Shopify serves the oldest supported version when an older one is asked for.
